G0600.def:
ἀπο-καθ-ίστημι (ἀποκαθιστάω, Marc 9:12, Rec., -ιστάνω, LTTr.; cf. Actes 1:6; -κατιστάνω, WH), 
[in LXX chiefly for שׁוּב ;] 
__1. to restore, i.e. to a former condition: of health, Matthieu 12:13, Marc 3:5 8:25, Luc 6:10; of social or political affairs, Matthieu 17:11, Marc 9:12, Actes 1:6. 
__2. to give back, bring back: Hébreux 13:19 (so in π., MM, see word; cf. also Cremer, 312).†

G0601.def:
ἀπο-καλύπτω 
[in LXX chiefly for גָּלָה ] 
__1. in general sense (cl.), to reveal, uncover, disclose, 
__(a) of things: Matthieu 10:26, Luc 2:35 12:2, 1 Corinthiens 3:13; 
__(b) of persons: pass., Christ, Luc 17:30; Antichrist, 2 Thessaloniciens 2:3 2:6 2:8 
__2. In LXX and NT, in special sense of divine revelation: Matthieu 11:25 (on the tense, see M, Pr., 136), ib. Matthieu 11:27 16:17, Luc 10:21-22, Jean 12:38, Romains 1:17-18 8:18, 1 Corinthiens 2:10 14:30, Galates 1:16 3:23, Éphésiens 3:5, Philippiens 3:15, 1 Pierre 1:5-12 5:1 (Westc., Eph., 178 f.; M, Th., 149 f.).†
SYN.: φανερόω (see Thayer, 62; Cremer, 342).†

G0602.def:
ἀπο-κάλυψις, -εως, ἡ
(ἀποκαλύπτω), [in LXX: 1 Rois 20:30 (עֶרְוָה), Sir.11:27 22:22 42:1 * ;] 
an uncovering, laying bare (Plut.). Metaphorical, a reveal­ing, revelation: a disclosure of divine truth, or a manifestion from God: Luc 2:32 Romains 2:5 8:19 16:25, 1 Corinthiens 1:7 14:6 14:26, 2 Corinthiens 12:1 12:7, Galates 1:12 2:2, Éphésiens 1:17 3:3 2 Thessaloniciens 1:7 1 Pierre 1:7 1:13 4:13, Apocalypse 1:1.†
SYN.: ἐπιφάνεια, παρουσία, φανέρωσις (see Tr., Syn., xciv; Lft., Notes, 102, 178; Westc, Eph., 178 f.; M, Th., 145 ff.; Cremer, 343)

G0603.def:
ἀπο-καραδοκία, -ας, ἡ
(ἀποκαραδοκέω, used by Aq. in Psaumes 37:7 for חוּל; ἀπό, κάρα the head, δοκέω, in Ion., to watch), 
to watch with outstretched head, watch anxiously (Polyb., π.; see Deiss., LAE, 374.5, 377 f.), Romains 8:19, Philippiens 1:20 (Lft., in l; Cremer, 177).†

G0604.def:
ἀπο-κατ-αλλάσσω
(cf. καταλλάσσω: ἀπό here signifies completely, see Lft., Col., l.with; Ellic., Eph., l.with; but also Mey., Eph., l.with), 
to reconcile completely: Éphésiens 2:16, Colossiens 1:20-21.†

G0605.def:
ἀπο-κατά-στασις, -εως, ἡ
(ἀποκαθίστημι), 
restoration: Actes 3:21 (in τ. of repairs and restorations of temples, see MM, see word).†

G0606.def:
ἀπό-κειμαι 
[in LXX: Genèse 49:10 (שִׁילֹה), Job 38:23 (חָשַׂךְ), 2Ma.12:45, 4Ma.8:11 * ;] 
to be laid up, in store, laid away: Luc 19:20. Metaphorical, C. dative of person(s), to be reserved (Dem., Plat.; and see MM, see word): Colossiens 1:5, 2 Timothée 4:8, Hébreux 9:27.†

G0607.def:
ἀπο-κεφαλίζω
(ἀπό, κεφαλή), [in LXX: Psaumes 151:7 * ;] 
to behead: Matthieu 14:10, Marc 6:16, 28 Luc 9:9.†

G0608.def:
ἀπο-κλείω 
[in LXX chiefly for סָגַר ;] 
to shut fast: Luc 13:25.†

G0609.def:
ἀπο-κόπτω 
[in LXX for קָצַץ, כָּרַת, etc. ;] 
to cut off: Marc 9:43, 45, Jean 18:10, 26 Actes 27:32. Mid., to mutilate oneself, have oneself mutilated: Galates 5:12 (cf. Deutéronome 23:1 LXX; and see Cremer, 751; MM, see word).†

G0610.def:
ἀπό-κριμα, -τος, τό
(ἀποκρίνω); 
__1. prop., a judicial sentence: 2 Corinthiens 1:9, R, mg. 
__2. an answer (see Thayer, see word): 2 Corinthiens 1:9, R, txt. (In FlJ, Ant., xiv, 10, 6, of a rescript of the Senate; in Inscr. of an official decision, Deiss., BS, 257; a reply to a deputation, MM, see word: cf. also Cremer, 3'75).†

G0611.def:
ἀποκρίνω, ἀποκρίνομαι, 
[in LXX chiefly for ענה ;] 
in cl., 
__1. to separate, distinguish. 
__2. to choose. 
Mid., to answer: Matthieu 27:12, Marc 14:61, Luc 3:16 23:9, Jean 5:17, 19 Actes 3:12. In late Gk. the pass, also is used in this sense, and pass. forms are the more frequently in NT (M, Pr., 39, 161; MM, see word); 
__(a) in general sense: absol., Marc 12:34; with accusative of thing(s), Matthieu 22:46; with dative of person(s), Matthieu 12:38; before πρός, Actes 25:16; 
__(b) Hebraistically 
__(i) like ענה, to begin to speak, take up the conversation (Kennedy, Sources, 124f.): Matthieu 11:25, al., 
__(ii) redundant, as in the Heb. phrase וַיַּעַן וַיּאֹמֶר (Dalman, Words, 24f., 38; M, Pr., 14; Bl., §58, 4; 74, 2; Cremer, 374): ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπε, Matthieu 4:4; ἔφη, 8:8; λέγει, Marc 3:33; in Jo most frequently (ἀπεκ. κ. εἶπε, 1:49. )

G0612.def:
ἀπό-κρισις, -εως, ἡ
(ἀποκρίνομαι), [in LXX for דָּבָר, etc. ;] 
an answering, an answer: Luc 2:47 20:26, Jean 1:22 19:9.†

G0613.def:
ἀπο-κρύπτω 
[in LXX chiefly for סָתַר ;] 
to hide, conceal, keep secret: with accusative, Luc 10:21; pass., 1 Corinthiens 2:7, Éphésiens 3:9, Colossiens 1:26 (MM, see word).†

G0614.def:
ἀπόκρυφος, -ον
(ἀποκρύπτω), [in LXX Chiefly for סֵתֶר ;] 
hidden: Marc 4:22, Luc 8:17, Colossiens 2:3 (see Lft., in l; MM, see word).†

G0615.def:
ἀπο-κτείνω
(also in late forms -κτέννω, Matthieu 10:28, a1., LTTr., -κτεννύω, Marc 12:5, WH), [in LXX for הָרַג, מוּת ;] 
to kill: Matthieu 14:5, al.; before instr. ἐν (which see), Éphésiens 2:16, Apocalypse 2:23, al. Metaphorical: Romains 7:11; τ. ἔχθραν, Éphésiens 2:16; τὸ γράμμα ἀποκτείνει 2 Corinthiens 3:6 (on the perfective force of this verb, see M, Pr., 114)

G0616.def:
ἀπο-κυέω
(Rec. -κύω), -ῶ (ἀπό, κυέω or κύω, to be pregnant), [in LXX: 4Ma.15:17 * ;] 
prop., "the medical word for birth as the close of pregnancy" (Hort, Ja., 26 f.). In κοιν, "an ordinary syn. of τίκτω, but definitely 'perfectivised' (M, Pr., 111 ff.; MM, see word) by the
ἀπό, and so implying safe delivery," to bring forth, give birth to: Jacques 1:15, 18.†

G0617.def:
ἀπο-κυλίω
(see: κυλίω), [in LXX: Genèse 29:3, 8 29:10 (גָּלַל) Jdth.13:9 * ;] 
to roll away: Matthieu 28:2, Marc 16:3, Luc 24:2.†

G0618.def:
ἀπο-λαμβάνω 
[in LXX: Nombres 34:14 (לָקַח (Deutéronome 25:5 A, Ésaïe 5:17, 2Ma.4:46 2Mac 6:21 2Mac 8:6, 4Ma.18:23 * ;] 
__1. to receive from another; absol., to receive as one's due: Luc 16:25 18:30 (seel. λάβῃ) Luc 23:41, Romains 1:27, Galates 4:5, Colossiens 3:24, 2Jn.8. 
__2. to receive back: Luc 6:34 15:27. 
__3. to take apart or aside: Marc 7:33 (cf. use in π. of the recluses of the Serapeum; MM, see word).†

G0619.def:
ἀπόλαυσις, -εως, ἡ
(ἀπολαύω, to take of, enjoy a thing) [in LXX: 3Ma.7:16 * ;] 
enjoyment: 1 Timothée 6:17, Hébreux 11:26 (for late exx., see MM, see word).†

G0620.def:
ἀπο-λείπω 
[in LXX for H2308 יָתַר, etc. ;] 
__1. to leave, leave behind (in π. a term. techn. in wills; see MM, see word): 2 Timothée 4:13 4:20, Tite 1:5; pass., to be reserved, remain: Hébreux 4:6, 9 10:26. 
__2. to desert, abandon: Ju 6.†

G0621.def:
ἀπο-λείχω
(for ἐπιλ-, which see), 
to lick up: Luc 16:21, Rec.†

G0623.def:
Ἀπολλύων, -οντος, ὁ
(present ptcp. of ἀπολλύω), 
Apollyon, i.e. the Destroyer: Apocalypse 9:11 (cf. Ἀβάδδων). (Cremer, 453; DB, i, 125, 172.) †

G0624.def:
Ἀπολλωνία, -ας, ἡ 
Apollonia, a city of Macedonia: Actes 17:1.†

G0625.def:
Ἀπολλώς, -ώ, ὁ
(perh. contr. from Ἀπολλώνιος, Actes 18:24 D) 
Apollos: Actes 18:24 19:1, 1 Corinthiens 1:12 3:4-6 3:22 4:6 16:12, Tite 3:13.†

G0626.def:
ἀπολογέομαι, -οῦμαι
(ἀπό, λόγος), [in LXX: Jérémie 12:1 (רִיב) Jérémie 31:6, 2Ma.13:26 * ;] 
__1. to defend: with accusative, Romains 2:15. 
__2. to defend one's self: absol., Luc 21:14, Actes 26:1; before ὅτι, Actes 25:8; τί, to adduce something in one's defence, Luc 12:11, Actes 26:24 (ταῦτα) Actes 24:10 (τὰ περὶ ἐμαυτοῦ); περί, with genitive of thing(s), and ἐπί, with genitive of person(s), Actes 26:2; with dative of person(s), Actes 19:33, 2 Corinthiens 12:19.†

G0627.def:
ἀπολογία, -ας, ἡ
(ἀπολογέομαι), [in LXX: Wis.6:10 * ;] 
a speech in defence: Actes 25:16, 2 Corinthiens 7:11, Philippiens 1:7, 16, 2 Timothée 4:16; with dative of person(s), 1 Corinthiens 9:3, 1 Pierre 3:15; before πρός, Actes 22:1.†

G0628.def:
ἀπο-λούω 
[in LXX: Job 9:30 (רָחַץ)* ;] 
to wash off, wash away; mid., metaphorically, with accusative of thing(s), to wash off oneself: ἀμαρτίας, Actes 22:16; absol., ἀπελούσασθε, ye washed yourselves clean (cf. Cremer, 406), 1 Corinthiens 6:11.†

G0629.def:
ἀπο-λύτρωσις, -εως, ἡ
(ἀπολυτρόω, to release on payment of ransom, cf. λύτρον), [in LXX: Da (LXX) Daniel 4:30 with * ;] 
release effected by pay­ment of ransom, redemption, deliverance; metaphorically, Hébreux 11:35; of deliverance thr. Christ from evil and the consequences of sin: Luc 21:28, Romains 3:24 (Vau., in l) 8:23, 1 Corinthiens 1:30, Éphésiens 1:7, 14 4:30, Colossiens 1:14, Hébreux 9:15. (On the extent to WH. the word retains the sense of ransom, see ICC, Romains 3:24, Westc., He., 297 ff.; see also ICC, Eph., 11; DCG, ii, 605; Cremer, 410; Deiss., LAE, 331; Lft., Notes, 271, 316; Tr., Syn., § 77.)†

G0630G.def:
ἀπο-λύω 
[in LXX for שׁוּב, etc., frequently in 1-4 Mac ;] 
__1. to set free, release: Luc 13:12, Jean 19:10, al.; a debtor, Matthieu 18:27; metaphorically, of forgive­ness, Luc 6:37. 
__2. to let go, dismiss (Field, Notes, 9 f.): Matthieu 15:23, Luc 2:29 9:12, Actes 19:41, al.; of divorce, τ. γυναῖκα: Matthieu 1:19 5:31-32 19:3, 8 19:10 Marc 10:2, 4 10:11, Luc 16:18; with ref. to Gk. and Rom. (net Jewish) custom, τ. ἄνδρα: Marc 10:12. Mid., to depart: Actes 28:25 (MM, see word)

G0630H.def:
ἀπο-λύω 
[in LXX for שׁוּב, etc., frequently in 1-4 Mac ;] 
__1. to set free, release: Luc 13:12, Jean 19:10, al.; a debtor, Matthieu 18:27; metaphorically, of forgive­ness, Luc 6:37. 
__2. to let go, dismiss (Field, Notes, 9 f.): Matthieu 15:23, Luc 2:29 9:12, Actes 19:41, al.; of divorce, τ. γυναῖκα: Matthieu 1:19 5:31-32 19:3, 8 19:10 Marc 10:2, 4 10:11, Luc 16:18; with ref. to Gk. and Rom. (net Jewish) custom, τ. ἄνδρα: Marc 10:12. Mid., to depart: Actes 28:25 (MM, see word)

G0631.def:
απο-μάσσω
(μάσσω, Att... -ττω, to touch, handle), [in LXX: Tob.7:17 * ;] 
to wipe off, wire clean: mid., Luc 10:11.†

G0632.def:
ἀπο-νέμω
(νέμω, to distribute), [in LXX: Deutéronome 4:19 (חָלַק), 3Ma.1:7 3Mac 3:16 * ;] 
to assign, apportion: 1 Pierre 3:7. (In π. of a Prefect who renders to all their dues; see MM, see word)†

G0633.def:
ἀπο-νίπτω 
[in LXX for שָׁטַף, רָחַץ, מָחָה ;] 
to wash off: mid. (reflex.), τ. χεῖρας, Matthieu 27:24.†

G0634.def:
ἀπο-πίπτω 
[in LXX for מָלַל, נָפַל, etc. ;] 
to fall off: Actes 9:18.†

G0635.def:
ἀπο-πλανάω, -ῶ 
[in LXX for נָדַח hi., נָטָה hi., שׁוּב pi. ;] 
to cause to go astray; metaphorically, of leading into error: Marc 13:22; pass., to be led astray: 1 Timothée 6:10.†

G0638.def:
ἀπο-πνίγω 
[in LXX: Nahum 2:13 (חָנַק pi.), Tob.3:8 * ;] 
to choke: Matthieu 13:7, Luc 8:7; pass., of drowning (= καταποντίζομαι), Luc 8:33.†

G0639.def:
ἀπορέω, -ῶ
(ἄπορος, ἀ- neg., πόρος, a way, resource), [in LXX for צָרַר, מוּךְ, etc. ;] 
to be at a loss, be perplexed: absol., Marc 6:20 (ἐποίει, R, mg.); mid., be in doubt: absol., 2 Corinthiens 4:8; with accusative, Actes 25:20; before περί, Luc 24:4; ἐν, Galates 4:20; περὶ τίνος λέγει, Jean 13:22.†
SYN.: διαπορέω, διακρίνομαι, διστάζω, μετεωρίζομαι (see DCG, i, 491)

G0640.def:
ἀπορία, -ας, ἡ
(ἀπορέω), [in LXX for בֶּהָלָה, etc. ;] 
perplexity: Luc 21:25 (MM, see word; on the construction, see Field, Notes, 74 f.).†

G0641.def:
ἀπο-ρίπτω
(Rec. -ρρίπτω, c1.), [in LXX for שָׁלַךְ hi., etc. ;] 
to throw away, cast forth: reflexively, Actes 27:43 (BV, cast themselves overboard; see MM, see word).†

G0642.def:
ἀπ-ορφανίζω
(ἀπό, ὀρφανός), 
to be bereaved (prop., of a parent, Lft., Notes, 36); metaphorically, 1 Thessaloniciens 2:17 (where Field thinks it = χωρισθέντες, Notes, 199).†

G0643.def:
ἀπο-σκευάζω 
[in LXX: Lévitique 14:36 (פָּנָה pi.) * ;] 
to pack and carry off; mid., to pack and remove one's goods: Actes 21:15, Rec. (see ἐπισ-).†
ἐπι-σκευάζω, 
[in LXX for pm pi., etc. ;] 
to equip, make ready; mid., to make one's preparations: Actes 21:15.†

G0644.def:
ἀπο-σκίασμα, -τος, τό
(ἀποσκιάζω, to cast a shadow; v,s. σκία) 
a shadow: Jacques 1:17 (MM, see word).†

G0645.def:
ἀπο-σπάω, -ῶ 
[in LXX for נָתַק: ni., hi., etc. ;] 
to draw off or away, tear away (MM, see word): Actes 20:30; μάχαιραν, draw a sword, Matthieu 26:51; pass., to be parted or withdrawn (Field, Notes, 134; but see Thayer, see word), Luc 22:41, Actes 21:1.†

G0646.def:
άποστασία, -ας, ἡ
(ἀφίστημι), [in LXX for מַעַל, etc. ;] 
defection, apostasy, revolt; in late Gk. (MM, Exp., viii; Lft., Notes, 111; Cremer, 308) for cl. ἀπόστασις, frequently in sense of political revolt, in LXX (e.g. Josué 22:22, 2 Chroniques 29:19, Jérémie 2:19) and NT always of religious apostasy: Actes 21:21, 2 Thessaloniciens 2:3.†

G0647.def:
ἀποστάσιον, -ου, τό
(ἀφίστημι), [in LXX; Deutéronome 24:1, 3, Jérémie 3:8, Ésaïe 50:1 (כְּרִיתוּת) * ;] 
__1. in cl., only in phrase ἀποστασίου δίκη, an action against a freedman for forsaking his προστάτης (Dem.). 
__2. In LXX, βιβλίον ἀποστασίου, a bill of divorce: Matthieu 19:7, Marc 10:4; in same sense ἀ. alone (MM, see word), Matthieu 5:31 (for other late exx., see MM, l.with; Kennedy, Sources, 121).†

G0648.def:
ἀπο-στεγάζω
(στέγη), [in Sm.: Jérémie 29:11 * ;] 
to unroof: Marc 2:4.†

G0650.def:
ἀπο-στερέω, -ῶ
(στερέω, to rob), [in LXX: Exode 21:10 (גָּרַע), Deutéronome 24:14 (עָשַׁק), Malachie 3:5, Sir.4:1 29:6-7 31:21-22 * ;] 
to defraud, deprive of, despoil (in cl. chiefly of the misappropriation of trust funds, Field, Notes, 33; cf. MM, see word): absol., Marc 10:19, 1 Corinthiens 6:8; with accusative of person(s), 1 Corinthiens 7:5. Mid., endure deprivation: 1 Corinthiens 6:7 (WM, § 38, 3; but see Bl., § 54, 5; M, Pr., 162); pass., ἀπεστερημένοι, bereft of: 1 Timothée 6:5.†

G0651.def:
ἀπο-στολή, -ῆς, ἡ
(ἀποστέλλω), [in LXX: Deutéronome 22:7, 3Ki.4:34 9:16 Psaumes 78:49, Ecclésiaste 8:8, Cantique des cantiques 4:13 (for שָׁלַח and its cognates), 1Es.9:51 Esther 9:54, Jérémie 32:36, Bar.2:25, 1Ma.2:18, 2Ma.3:2 *.] 
__1. In cl., a sending away (MM, see word), as, an expedition (Hdt.). 
__2. In LXX 
__(a) discharge, dis­missal (Ecclésiaste 8:8); 
__(b) a gift (3Ki.9:16, 1Ma.2:13). 
__3. In NT, the office of an Apostle of Christ, apostleship: Actes 1:25, Romains 1:5, 1 Corinthiens 9:2, Galates 2:8 (Cremer, 530).†

G0652.def:
ἀπόστολος, -ου, ὁ
(ἀοστέλλω), [in LXX; 3Ki.14:6 A (שָׁלַח) * ;] 
__1. a fleet, an expedition (Dem.). 
__2. a messenger, one sent on a mission (Hdt., LXX, l.with, and π.; see M, Pr., 37 f.; MM, see word; M, Th., i, 2:7 and reff.): Jean 13:16, 2 Corinthiens 8:23 Philippiens 2:25. 
__3. In NT, an Apostle of Christ 
__(a) with special ref. to the Twelve: Matthieu 10:2, Marc 3:14, Luc 11:49, Éphésiens 3:5, Apocalypse 18:20, al., equality with whom is claimed by St. Paul, Galates 1:1, 11 ff, 1 Timothée 2:7, a1.; 
__(b) in a wider sense of prominent Christian teachers, as Barnabas, Actes 14:14, apparently also Silvanus and Timothy, 1 Thessaloniciens 2:6, and perhaps Andronicus and Junias (Junia?), Romains 16:7 (see ICC, in l); of false teachers, claiming apostleship: 2 Corinthiens 11:5 11:13, Apocalypse 2:2. (On the different uses of the term in NT, see Lit., Gal., 92-101; Cremer, 530; DB, i, 126; DCG, i, 105; Enc. Br., ii, 196 ff.)

G0653.def:
ἀποστοματίζω
(στόμα), 
__1. In cl., to speak from memory, to dic­tate to a pupil (Plat.). 
__2. In late Gk., to catechize, question: Luc 11:53 (MM, see word).†

G0654.def:
ἀπο-στρέφω 
[in LXX chiefly for שׁוּב ;] 
trans., with accusative, 
__(a) to turn away, remove: Romains 11:26, 2 Timothée 4:4; metaphorically, to turn away from allegiance, pervert: Luc 23:14; 
__(b) to turn back, return: μάχαιραν, Matthieu 26:52. Pass., reflex., to turn oneself away from: with accusative, Matthieu 5:42, 2 Timothée 1:15, Tite 1:14, Hébreux 12:25; so act., absol., Actes 3:26 (cf. Sir.8:5; Bl., § 53, 1; Cremer, 880).†

G0655.def:
ἀπο-στυγέω, -ῶ
(στυγέω, to hate), 
to abhor: Romains 12:9.†

G0656.def:
ἀποσυνάγωγος, -ον
(συναγωγή), 
expelled from the congregation (Field, Notes, 96), excommunicated: Jean 9:22 12:42 16:2 (Cremer, 64, 607).†

G0657.def:
ἀπο-τάσσω 
[in LXX: Ecclésiaste 2:20 (יָאַשׁ pi.), I Esther 6:27, Jérémie 20:2, 1-18; 1Ma.4:1-61 * ;] 
to set apart. Mid., in late Gk. (El., § 37, 1; Swete, Mk., 136 f.; MM, e. dative, 
__(a) to take leave of: Marc 6:46, Luc 9:61, Actes 18:18, 21, 2 Corinthiens 2:13; 
__(b) to forsake: Luc 14:33.†

G0658.def:
ἀπο-τελέω, -ῶ 
[in LXX: I Esther 5:73, 1Ma.15:39 * ;] 
to bring to an end, complete, accomplish (cf. MM, see word): Luc 13:32, Jacques 1:15.†

G0659.def:
ἀπο-τίθημι 
[in LXX chiefly for נוּחַ hi. ;] 
to put off or aside; in NT always mid., 
__(a) to put of from oneself as a garment: τ. ἱμάτια, Actes 7:58; metaphorically, in ethical sense, to put of, lay aside: Romains 13:12, Éphésiens 4:22, 25, Colossiens 3:8, Hébreux 12:1, Jacques 1:21, 1 Pierre 2:1; 
__(b) to stow away, put: ἐν τ. φυλακῇ (MM, see word), Matthieu 14:3.†

G0660.def:
ἀπο-τινάσσω 
[in LXX: Juges 16:20 A (נָעַר ni.), 1 Rois 10:2 (נָטַשׁ), La 2:7 (נָאַר pi.) * ;] 
to shake of: Luc 9:5, Actes 28:5.†

G0661.def:
ἀπο-τίνω (or -τίω) 
[in LXX chiefly for שׂוּם pi. ;] 
to pay off, repay: Phm 19 (MM, see word).†

G0662.def:
ἀπο-τολμάω, -ῶ 
to be quite bold, make a bold venture: Romains 10:20.†

G0663.def:
ἀποτομία, -ας, ἡ
(ἀποτέμνω, to cut of), [in Sm.: Jérémie 51:35, Nahum 3:1 * ;] 
steepness, sharpness; metaphorically, severity (MM, see word): Romains 11:22.†

G0664.def:
ἀποτόμως 
adv., [in LXX: Wis.5:22 * ;] 
abruptly, curtly, hence sharply, severely: 2 Corinthiens 13:10, Tite 1:13 (MM, see word).†

G0665.def:
ἀπο-τρέπω 
[in LXX: Sir.20:29 48:18, 3Ma.1:23, 4Ma.1:33 4Mac 16:12 * ;] 
to turn away; mid., to turn oneself away from: with accusative, 2 Timothée 3:5.†

G0666.def:
ἀπουσία, -ας, ἡ
(ἄπειμι); 
__1. absence (Æsch., Thuc.): Philippiens 2:12, 
__2. deficiency, waste (MM, s.v).†

G0667.def:
ἀπο-φέρω 
[in LXX for הָלַךְ, etc. ;] 
to carry off, bear, or lead away: with accusative, Marc 15:1, 1 Corinthiens 16:3, Apocalypse 17:3 21:10. Pass., Luc 16:22, Actes 19:12.†

G0668.def:
ἀπο-φεύγω 
[in LXX: Sir.22:22 * ;] 
to flee from, escape: with accusative, 2 Pierre 2:18 2:20; with genitive, 2 Pierre 1:4.†

G0669.def:
ἀπο-φθέγγομαι 
[in LXX for נָבָא, etc. ;] 
to speak forth, give utterance: Actes 2:4, 14 26:25 (MM, s. see).†

G0670.def:
ἀπο-φορτίζομαι
(φορτίζω, to load), 
to discharge a cargo (Field, Notes, 134), to unlade: with accusative, τ. γόμον, Actes 21:3.†

G0671.def:
ἀπό-χρησις, -εως, ἡ
(ἀποχράομαι, to use to the full, abuse) 
abuse, misuse: Colossiens 2:22 (MM, see word).†

G0672.def:
ἀπο-χωρέω, -ῶ 
[in LXX: Jérémie 46:5 (סוּג), 2Ma.4:33, 3Ma.2:33 * ;] 
to go away, depart, withdraw: before ἀπό, Matthieu 7:23, Luc 9:39, Actes 13:13 (absol., Luc 20:20, Tr., mg.).†

G0673.def:
ἀπο-χωρίζω 
[in LXX: Eze.43:21 (מִפְקָד)* ;] 
to separate, part asunder: pass., Apocalypse 6:14; reflexively, to separate oneself: Actes 15:39.†

G0674.def:
ἀπο-ψύχω 
[in LXX: 4Ma.15:18 * ;] 
__1. to breathe out life, expire (Thue.; LXX, l.with). 
__2. to leave off breathing, faint (Hom., Od., xxiv, 348): before ἀπό, Luc 21:26.†

G0675.def:
Ἀππιος, -ου, ὁ 
Appius; Ἀππίου Φόρον, Appii Forum (Market of Appius), a town in Italy: Actes 28:15.†

G0676.def:
ἀ-πρόσ-ιτος, -ον
(πρόσειμι, to go to), 
unapproachable: φῶς, 1 Timothée 6:16.†

G0677.def:
ἀπρόσκοπος, -ον
(προσκόπτω), [in LXX: Sir.32:21, 3Ma.3:8 * ;] 
__1. act., not causing to stumble: metaphorically, of not leading others into sin, 1 Corinthiens 10:32. 
__2. Pass., not stumbling, without offence, blameless: Actes 24:16, Philippiens 1:10 (for exx., see MM, see word).†

G0678.def:
ἀπροσωπολήμπτως (Rec. -λήπτως, cl.), adv. 
(α- neg., προσωπολήμπτης), 
without respect of persons, impartially: 1 Pierre 1:17.†

G0679.def:
ἄ-πταιστος, -ον
(πταίω), [in LXX: 3Ma.6:39 * ;] 
without stumbling, sure-footed: metaphorically (MM, see word), Ju 24.†

G0681.def:
ἅπτω 
[in LXX chiefly for נָגַע ;] 
prop., to fasten to; hence, of fire, to kindle, light: Luc 8:16 11:33 15:8, Actes 28:2. Mid., with genitive, to fasten oneself to, cling to, lay hold of (so in π.; MM, see word): Matthieu 8:3, 15, Jean 20:17, al.; of carnal intercourse, 1 Corinthiens 7:1; with reference to levitical and ceremonial prohibitions, 2 Corinthiens 6:17, Colossiens 2:21; of hostile action, 1 Jean 5:18 (cf. ἀν-, καθ-, περι- άπτω) 
SYN.: θιγγάνω, ψηλαφάω. ἅ. is the stronger, θ., to touch, the lighter term. ψ. is to feel, as in search of something (Tr., Syn., § xvii; Lft., Col., 201 f.)

G0682.def:
Ἀπφία, -ας, ἡ 
Apphia: Phm 2 (MM, see word).†

G0683.def:
ἀπ-ωθέω, -ῶ 
[in LXX for זָנַח, מָאַס, etc. ;] 
to thrust away. Mid., to thrust away from oneself, refuse, reject: with accusative of person(s) (MM, see word), Actes 7:27, 39 13:46, Romains 11:1-2, 1 Timothée 1:19.†

G0684.def:
ἀπώλεια, -ας, ἡ
(ἀπόλλυμι), [in LXX (Cremer, 797) for אָבַד, אֵיד, etc. ;] 
destruction, waste, loss, perishing (in π., of money, see MM, see word): Matthieu 26:8, Marc 14:4, Actes 8:20, Romains 9:22, 1 Timothée 6:9, 2 Pierre 2:1; in special sense of the loss of eternal life, perdition, the antithesis of σωτηρία: Matthieu 7:13, Jean 17:12, Philippiens 1:28 3:19, 2 Thessaloniciens 2:3, Hébreux 10:39, 2 Pierre 2:3 3:7 3:16, Apocalypse 17:8, 11 (DB, iii, 744).†

G0685.def:
ἀρά, -ᾶς, ἡ 
[in LXX chiefly for אָלָה ]; 
__1. a prayer (MM, see word). 
__2. (as in Homer) a curse, malediction: Romains 3:14 (LXX),†

G0686.def:
ἄρα, 
illative particle, expressing a more subjective or informal inference than οὖν, 
then: prop. (as in cl.), the second word in the sentence, Romains 7:21 8:1, Galates 3:7; ἐπεὶ ἄρα, 1 Corinthiens 7:14 (with another word between) 5:10; as the first word, Luc 11:48, Actes 11:18, Romains 10:17, 1 Corinthiens 15:18, 2 Corinthiens 5:15 7:12, Hébreux 4:9; so prop. in apodosis after protasis with εἰ, Matthieu 12:28, Luc 11:20, Galates 2:21 3:29 5:11, Hébreux 12:8 (κενὸν ἄρα), 1 Corinthiens 15:14; often in interrogations, direct and indirect, τίς (τί) ἄρα, Matthieu 18:1 19:25, 27 24:45, Marc 4:41, Luc 1:66 8:25 12:42 22:23, Actes 12:18; εἰ ἄρα, Marc 11:13, Actes 8:22; εἴπερ ἄρα, 1 Corinthiens 15:15; οὐκ ἄρα, Actes 21:38; μήτι ἄρα, 2 Corinthiens 1:17; in strengthened forms, ἄρα γε, ἄραγε, Matthieu 7:20 17:26, Actes 17:27, and more frequently ἄρα οὖν (Epp. Paul.), so then, Romains 5:18 7:3, 25 8:12 9:16, 18 14:19, Galates 6:10, Éphésiens 2:19, 1 Thessaloniciens 5:6, 2 Thessaloniciens 2:15 (Bl., §77, 2; 78, 5; MM, see word).†

G0687.def:
ἆρα, 
interrog. particle, 
implying anxiety or impatience, "quite rare and only in Luke and Paul, therefore a literary word" (Bl., §77, 2). 
__1. (num igitur) expecting a neg. reply, Luc 18:8; ἆρά γε, Actes 8:30. 
__2. (ergone) in apodosis, expecting an affirm. reply, Galates 2:17 (Bl., l.with; Lft., Ga., in l.; MM, see word).
†

G0688.def: Arabia , (Herdotus Historicus), poetry Ἀρραβία, (Theocritus Poeta Bucolicus) (ML)

G0689.def:
Ἀράμ indec. (Heb. רָם), 
Aram: Matthieu 1:3-4, Luc 3:33 (R, txt., WH, Ἀρνεί).†

G0691.def:
ἀργέω, -ῶ
(ἀργός), [in LXX: Esther 4:24, Ecclésiaste 12:3 (בָּטֵל), I Esther 2:30, Sir.33:27), 2Ma.5:25 * ;] 
to be idle; τὸ κρίμα . . . ἀ., lingers (cf. MGr. ἀργά, late: MM, see word): 2 Pierre 2:3.†

G0692.def:
ἀργός, -όν
(in late Gk., incl. NT, -ή, -όν; ἀ- neg., ἔργον) [in LXX: 3Ki.6:7 (מַסָּע), Wis.14:5 15:15, Sir.37:11 38:28 * ;] 
inactive, idle: Matthieu 20:3, 6, 1 Timothée 5:13, Tite 1:12, 2 Pierre 1:8. Metaphorical, of things, inactive, ineffective, worthless: ῥῆμα, Matthieu 12:36; πίστις, Jacques 2:20 (see Cremer, 259 f.).†
SYN.: βραδύς, slow; νωθρός, sluggish (Tr., Syn., § civ)

G0693.def:
ἀργύρεος (see MM, see word), -οῦς, -ᾶ, -οῦν 
(ἄργυρος), [in LXX for כֶּסֶף ;] 
of silver: Actes 19:24 (WH, br.), 2 Timothée 2:20, Apocalypse 9:20.†

G0695.def:
ἀργυροκόπος, -ου, ὁ
(ἄργυρος, κόπτω, to beat) [in LXX: Juges 17:4, Jérémie 6:29 (צָרַף) * ;] 
a silversmith: Actes 19:24 (Plut.; 77., see MM, see word).†

G0696.def:
ἄργυρος, -ου, ὁ
(ἀργός, shining), [in LXX for כֶּסֶף ;] 
silver (on its relation to ἀργύριον, see MM, see word): Matthieu 10:9, Actes 17:29, Jacques 5:5, Apocalypse 18:12.†

G0697.def:
Ἄρειος Πάυος (T, Ἄριος Π.), -ου, ὁ 
Hill of Pres or Mars, Areopagus; also, the Court of Areopagus, the highest tribunal of Athens: Actes 17:19, 22.†

G0698.def:
Ἀρεοπαγίτης (T, -είτης), -ου, ὁ (see supr.), 
a judge of the Court of Areopagus: Actes 17:34.†

G0699.def:
ἀρεσκία (Rec. -εία), -ας, ἡ 
(ἀρέσκω), [in LXX (-εία): Proverbes 31:30 (חֵן) * ;] 
pleasing, desire to please: Colossiens 1:19 In Gk. writers (Arist., Polyb.), most frequently in bad sense, but in π., Inscr., and in Philo, as above (see Deiss., BS, 224; MM, see word; Cremer, 642).†
